speaker: big_mike
transcript:
Yeah.

That’s him.

Same jacket. Same head.

But, Rich... he was gone.

I felt his neck break. He dropped and never took another breath.

I don’t understand how he got to you.

I can’t get up. Every time I move, the bleeding starts again.

No antigen.

Don’t waste it on a knife wound.

Listen to me.

If I come to your door, you do not answer.

I don’t care what I say or how much I sound like me.

Keep it shut.

I’m just gonna rest a minute.

I’ll call you.
summary: Mike admits he cannot stand and warns Rich not to trust him at the door.
